l1_connect_account.title: Bring unmonitored AI environments into view
l1_connect_account.why: The environment is in use, but nothing reports what models, agents and keys it holds, so no control can be checked there.
steps: Find who runs the environment and what AI services it uses, including ones adopted without a request.
Connect the environment's logs and inventory source.
Record who owns each model, agent and key.
l1_connect_account.success: Every known AI environment reports its models, agents and keys.
